recipes.name: The Easiest PB&J (3 Ingredients)
ingredients: 2-3 Tbsp (32-48g) creamy peanut butter (or crunchy if you prefer)
2 Tbsp (40g) strawberry jelly or jam (Bonne Maman preferred)
instructions: Take your favorite white bread, your favorite peanut butter, and your best strawberry jam, and layer them up.
Slice on the diagonal, serve and enjoy.
